items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: He started with me when he was quite young, going to play second cornet.

ctx.x: He started with me when he was quite young, going to play second cornet. His boy had a good tone and he could make high notes and had a good drag time in his head and everything like that and I just thought maybe he made good enough. He was hard to get along with. Especially with my kind of a work I had.
Oh yeah. Was he working with you when Solistan was in your band?
